description: Bright and stylish apartment located directly on the Champs-Élysées, offering a truly unique Parisian experience. High-end bedding, an elegant living area with a smart TV and fast Wi-Fi, a fully equipped modern kitchen (Nespresso included), and a refined bathroom. Prestigious neighborhood in the heart of Paris, close to the Arc de Triomphe and luxury boutiques. Flexible check-in and impeccable cleanliness for a stay combining comfort and elegance. Integrated split air conditioning ensures optimal comfort year-round.• Master suite: a spacious bedroom with high-end bedding, built-in storage, and a private en-suite bathroom equipped with a modern shower and premium finishes. Split air conditioning in the bedroom for perfect comfort.• Second bedroom: comfortable and elegant, offering premium bedding, practical storage, and split air conditioning for a restful stay.• Third bedroom: ideal for family, friends, or colleagues, featuring quality bedding, functional storage, and a warm atmosphere.
